tools.name: compliance_theater_case_files_get
tools.description: Retrieve case-file documents either directly without preprocessing or through goal-based batch extraction. Exposed as compliance_theater_case_files_get.

mode.description: direct returns full-fidelity unsummarized documents, up to 3 IDs; goals uses the batch preprocessor with optional goals and fidelity.

caseFileId.description: Single case-file ID. Convenience alias for ids with one item.

ids.description: Case-file IDs to retrieve. Direct mode allows at most 3 IDs.

goals.description: Shared extraction or summary goals for goals mode.

verbatim_fidelity.description: Shared fidelity target for goals mode.

isError.description: Whether the app route reported an error.

documentType.description: Case-file document type, such as email, attachment, note, key_point, cta, or cta_response.

content.description: Full-fidelity, unsummarized text content for the requested case file.

docRel_sourceDoc.description: Documents related where this case file is the source.

docRel_targetDoc.description: Documents related where this case file is the target.

docProp.description: Primary structured document property metadata, when available.

email.description: Email metadata and linked email details for email case files.

emailAttachment.description: Attachment metadata for attachment case files.

tools.name: compliance_theater_case_files_amend
tools.description: Amend structured case-file document details, ratings, notes, and relationships. Exposed as compliance_theater_case_files_amend.

completionRating.description: Rates how close to fully complete the call to action is.

relationshipType.description: How the related document connects to the target document.

explanation.description: Reason the amendment is being made.
